notes.S1: Thin-outline lorry symbol identifies heavy goods vehicles only in containing sign context.
notes.S2: Lorry with trailer remains an attached-trailer class qualification, not an independent prohibition.
notes.S3: Thin-outline passenger car identifies passenger cars; alternatives are visually/semantically distinct.
notes.S4: Partly cropped car with centre-axle trailer matches slapkärra qualification, not universal trailer class.
notes.S5: Outline bus is a symbol requiring containing instruction, not standalone lane restriction.
notes.S6: Tractor outline covers tractors and class-II motorised equipment; red C8 prohibition is separate.
notes.S7: Motorcycle outline includes two-wheeled motorcycles and class-I mopeds without sidecars, not all mopeds.
notes.S8: Bicycle outline identifies bicycles/class-II mopeds, distinct from classI.
notes.S9: Trailer above horizontal base identifies centre-axle trailer; surrounding sign provides duty.
notes.S10: Adult holding child identifies pedestrian group, not a standalone pedestrian-only order.
notes.S11: Wheelchair outline identifies mobility disability without standalone parking entitlement.
notes.S12: Motor caravan outline denotes personbil klassII; not every camping vehicle. Also carries X9 alternative description finding.
notes.S13: Canopied passenger boat denotes passenger ferry without car-carriage promise.
notes.T1: Two range panels200–800m and0–1.2km state affected section endpoints, distinct from T2 distance.
notes.T2: 100m is distance to feature, not length of section.
notes.T6: 8–17/(8–14)/red8–13 retain weekday/day-before-holiday/Sunday-holiday distinctions plus named-day and overnight rules.
notes.T8: Lorry symbol qualifies main sign to that class and time qualifications, not standalone ban. Also carries X9 alternative description finding.
notes.T22: Text is additional written qualification of main sign, not an independent destination.
notes.X8: Red X over faint P cancels destination guidance temporarily, not a general all-traffic road closure.
